title: Asymptotic Metrics for Higher-Rank Monopoles
exact_target: Control the higher-rank monopole metric near every compactification boundary and compare it with the SU(2) cluster asymptotics.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002074 (OWR-11787-005). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Analysis and Geometric Singularities (2012), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2012/25, pp. 1487--1562; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF page 21, printed page 1507.
Bielawski, Asymptotic metrics for SU(N)-monopoles with maximal symmetry breaking; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.
Kottke--Singer, Partial compactification of monopoles and metric asymptotics; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The target includes arbitrary permitted magnetic-charge vectors and the compactification's cluster strata, rather than a single separated-charge example. The source calls this work in progress; local metric approximations alone do not yield the requested uniform quasi-isometric control across all relevant regions.
